(AP Photo/Kyusung Gong)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Thomas Lagrone | tlagrone@al.comThe Los Angeles Dodgers play against the New York Mets in an MLB game today. The matchup will begin at 9 p.m. CT on ESPN. Fans can watch this game for free online by using the free trials offered by DIRECTV and Fubo TV. Alternatively, Sling offers an affordable monthly subscription.Notably, both teams will wear unique uniforms for Jackie Robinson Day this evening. Each player will wear the No. 42 on their jersey, and it will feature a dodger blue color. The Dodgers have played well this season, as they enter this game with a 13-4 record, and they have won back-to-back games. In their last game, the Dodgers defeated the Mets 2-1. In order to win this game, the Dodgers will need to rely on their star player Shohei Ohtani. He leads the team with five home runs, and he will be the starting pitcher today. In his two pitching starts, Ohtani has a 1-0 record and a 0.00 ERA. The Mets enter this game with a 7-11 record, and they have lost seven consecutive games. In order to bounce back today, the Mets will need a great performance from their outfielder Luis Robert Jr. He leads the team with a .259 batting average this year.Baseball fans can catch today’s action for free online by using the free trials offered by DIRECTV and Fubo TV.
